Question: What is the selection process of the UPSC selection post recruitment?
Old_Answer: Step 1: Scrutiny of the application is done by the UPSC to see if you meet the eligibility criteria (both education and/or experience) Step 2: A list of shortlisted candidates is published on the UPSC website and a chance is given to the un-shortlisted candidates to make representations if they think they should have been included. They can write and email to the UPSC. Step 3: The UPSC can hold a written examination for the post depending on the number of candidates. The written test is always followed by an interview. Else, there is only an interview. Step 4: UPSC conducts the interview at UPSC Bhawan, New Delhi. The scrutiny criteria is generally quite peculiar for specific posts and number of vacancies is also mostly quite low.
